reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: California
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Must a landlord accept a tenant's attempt to cure for material breach?
*/

/* =========================
   STATUTES (TRANSLATION)
   ========================= */

/* [1] CA St & Hwy Code  1161 (2021)
   "Any portion of a county, not already contained in a division, may be formed into a division..."
   (Not landlord/tenant related; encoded for completeness.)
*/
% statute_shc_1161_can_form_division(+CountyPortion)
% Deterministic: succeeds iff the county portion is not already in a division.
statute_shc_1161_can_form_division(CountyPortion) :-
    county_portion(CountyPortion),
    \+ already_contained_in_division(CountyPortion).

/* [2] CA Civ Proc Code  1161.5 (2021)
   If the notice required by Section 1161 states that the lessor/landlord may elect to declare
   forfeiture, that declaration is nullified and the lease remains in effect if:
     (a) tenant performs within 3 days after service of the notice, OR
     (b) landlord waives the breach after service of the notice.
*/
% statute_ccp_1161_5_applies(+Notice)
statute_ccp_1161_5_applies(Notice) :-
    notice_required_by_section_1161(Notice),
    notice_states_landlord_may_elect_forfeiture(Notice).

% performed_within_three_days_after_service(+Tenant,+Lease,+Notice)
performed_within_three_days_after_service(Tenant, Lease, Notice) :-
    tenant(Tenant),
    lease(Lease),
    notice(Notice),
    notice_service_day(Notice, ServiceDay),
    tenant_performance_day(Tenant, Lease, PerformanceDay),
    Delta is PerformanceDay - ServiceDay,
    Delta >= 0,
    Delta =< 3.

% landlord_waived_breach_after_service(+Landlord,+Notice)
landlord_waived_breach_after_service(Landlord, Notice) :-
    landlord(Landlord),
    notice(Notice),
    landlord_waiver_day(Landlord, Notice, WaiverDay),
    notice_service_day(Notice, ServiceDay),
    WaiverDay >= ServiceDay.

% statute_ccp_1161_5_forfeiture_declaration_nullified(+Landlord,+Tenant,+Lease,+Notice)
statute_ccp_1161_5_forfeiture_declaration_nullified(Landlord, Tenant, Lease, Notice) :-
    statute_ccp_1161_5_applies(Notice),
    (
        performed_within_three_days_after_service(Tenant, Lease, Notice)
    ;
        landlord_waived_breach_after_service(Landlord, Notice)
    ).

% statute_ccp_1161_5_lease_remains_in_effect(+Lease,+Landlord,+Tenant,+Notice)
statute_ccp_1161_5_lease_remains_in_effect(Lease, Landlord, Tenant, Notice) :-
    statute_ccp_1161_5_forfeiture_declaration_nullified(Landlord, Tenant, Lease, Notice).

/* =========================
   LEGAL CONCLUSION (DERIVED)
   ========================= */

% legal_landlord_must_accept_cure(+Landlord,+Tenant,+Lease,+Notice)
% Interpreting "must accept an attempt to cure" as: landlord cannot treat lease as forfeited
% when CCP 1161.5 nullifies forfeiture upon timely performance (or waiver).
legal_landlord_must_accept_cure(Landlord, Tenant, Lease, Notice) :-
    statute_ccp_1161_5_lease_remains_in_effect(Lease, Landlord, Tenant, Notice).

/* =========================
   SCENARIO (FACTS)
   ========================= */

% Metadata
state(california).
focus_year(2021).

% Parties and instruments
landlord(landlord1).
tenant(tenant1).
lease(lease1).
notice(notice1).

% Scenario breach characterization (material breach mentioned by question)
breach_material(lease1).

% Notice facts relevant to CCP 1161.5
notice_required_by_section_1161(notice1).
notice_states_landlord_may_elect_forfeiture(notice1).

% Timing facts (use integer "days" for simple comparisons)
% Service on day 0
notice_service_day(notice1, 0).
% Tenant performed cure on day 2 (within three days after service)
tenant_performance_day(tenant1, lease1, 2).

% No waiver facts in this scenario (predicate exists but no facts asserted)
% landlord_waiver_day(Landlord, Notice, Day).  % intentionally absent

% Unrelated-to-question facts for CA St & Hwy Code  1161 encoding
county_portion(portion1).
already_contained_in_division(_Portion) :- fail.

% scenario_statement/0: succeeds when the encoded factual statement holds.
scenario_statement :-
    state(california),
    focus_year(2021),
    landlord(landlord1),
    tenant(tenant1),
    lease(lease1),
    notice(notice1),
    breach_material(lease1),
    notice_required_by_section_1161(notice1),
    notice_states_landlord_may_elect_forfeiture(notice1),
    notice_service_day(notice1, _),
    tenant_performance_day(tenant1, lease1, _).

/* =========================
   ANSWER
   ========================= */

housing_answer(Result) :-
    (   scenario_statement,
        legal_landlord_must_accept_cure(landlord1, tenant1, lease1, notice1)
    ->  Result = yes
    ;   Result = no
    ),
    !.

/* =========================
   MAIN
   ========================= */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Must a landlord accept a tenant's attempt to cure for material breach?
